name: Donely
tagline: Donely helps you host and manage OpenClaw-powered AI employees from one dashboard
description: Donely helps you host and manage OpenClaw-powered AI employees from one dashboard. You can deploy an agent in minutes, connect it to tools like Slack, Gmail, Notion, HubSpot, and more, then manage access, logs, billing, and performance in one place. It is built for people who want to start small with one instance and scale to many without migration, separate accounts, or DevOps.
